summary: Answer agents first pages at once from the newest published roster; waiting for a roster at least as new as the request is opt-in

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/agents first pages answer immediately from the newest published roster, with its cut and published_at, instead of waiting up to a second. A client that must see what was written before its read passes fresh=true. st agents ls and tree do; the Rust client gains agents_list_fresh. Older clients keep working and read instantly.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; reverting restores the bounded wait on every first page.
